name: brillouin-torus
title: Brillouin torus
description: A parametric torus with its two independent cycles highlighted; a geometric model of a two-dimensional Brillouin zone.

name: mobius-band
title: Möbius band
description: A ruled strip with a half twist. Its two parameter edges join into one continuous boundary.

name: hopf-fibres
title: Linked Hopf fibres
description: Eight fibres of the Hopf map stereographically projected from the three-sphere. Each pair is linked once; gaps preserve their projected over-under ordering.

name: trefoil-knot
title: Trefoil knot
description: A smooth tubular embedding of the (2,3) torus knot, with depth-sorted faces making its three crossings legible.

name: bloch-sphere
title: Bloch sphere
description: A unit sphere, coordinate axes, computational-basis poles and a normalized pure-qubit state vector. Back-facing curves are attenuated.

name: dirac-cone
title: Conical band crossing
description: Two energy sheets proportional to plus or minus the magnitude of momentum, shown as touching wireframe cones. An illustrative two-band dispersion, not measured data.

name: euler-winding
title: Euler winding
description: The planar vector (cos 2θ, sin 2θ) turns twice around one circuit of the origin. A schematic texture relevant to Euler band crossings.

name: node-braid
title: Band-node braid
description: Three smooth node trajectories with three exchanges and explicit crossing order, illustrating multiband node braiding.

name: surface-code
title: Surface-code stabilizers
description: A square-lattice bulk schematic with data qubits on edges, one four-qubit Z plaquette and one four-qubit X star. No finite-code boundary conditions are asserted.

name: toric-code
title: Toric-code lattice
description: A square cellulation of a torus with data qubits at edge midpoints and two noncontractible cycles highlighted. The qubit placement and periodic identifications form a toric-code lattice.

name: fano-plane
title: Fano plane
description: The seven points and seven three-point lines of PG(2,2). Nonzero binary vectors label points; every line has vector sum zero. Related to the Hamming and Steane code constructions.

name: quantum-circuit
title: GHZ preparation circuit
description: A Hadamard on the first of four zero-state qubits and a chain of three CNOT gates prepare (0000 plus 1111) divided by the square root of two.

name: syndrome-circuit
title: Stabilizer measurement
description: Four data-controlled CNOTs accumulate their computational-basis parity in a zero-state ancilla; measuring the ancilla in Z measures the four-body Z stabilizer.

name: kagome-lattice
title: Kagome lattice
description: A nearest-neighbour graph of corner-sharing triangles, a standard frustrated-spin geometry, with one six-site loop highlighted.

name: band-contours
title: Band-energy contours
description: Computed energy contours of the two-band toy Hamiltonian d dot sigma, with d = (sin kx, sin ky, 1.2 + cos kx + cos ky). Periodic momentum space is shown in oblique projection. Not measured data.

name: temporal-network
title: Temporal network
description: Three schematic snapshots of the same eight-node network, with changing edges and dotted inter-layer correspondences. No empirical network is implied.
